_comment: Provenance and clinical approval for each model, signed into weights/manifest.json by scripts/sign_model.py. The registry refuses any model that is missing here, is not marked approved, points at a different file, or whose manifest is older than one already accepted. Edit this file, then re-sign: a change here is worthless until it is signed, because the registry only ever reads the signed copy.

tooth_detector.notes: Set approval_status to 'approved' only after clinical validation, then re-sign.

landmarks.notes: Set approval_status to 'approved' only after clinical validation, then re-sign.

landmarks_2.notes: Optional landmark ensemble member. Not shipped; declared so that installing it meets the same gate as every other model.

landmarks_3.notes: Optional landmark ensemble member. Not shipped; declared so that installing it meets the same gate as every other model.

panoramic_screen.notes: Optional whole-film model. Set approval_status to approved only after clinical validation, then re-sign and countersign.

panoramic_severity.notes: Optional whole-film model. Set approval_status to approved only after clinical validation, then re-sign and countersign.
